BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Environment, Energy & Technology.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning court-ordered restitution in environmental criminal cases.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to court-ordered restitution in environmental criminal cases; adding a new section to chapter 90.48 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 70A.15 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 70A.300 RCW; and prescribing penalties.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 90.48 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: In determining restitution following a criminal conviction under this chapter or chapter 90.56 RCW, the court is authorized to order restitution for harm to natural resources or the environment.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 70A.15 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: In determining restitution following a criminal conviction under this chapter, the court is authorized to order restitution for harm to natural resources or the environment.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 3. A new section is added to chapter 70A.300 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: In determining restitution following a criminal conviction under this chapter, the court is authorized to order restitution for harm to natural resources or the environment.
